note: The Evening Edition's stories, rewritten for bedtime by the local model. Tonight's copy was fact-checked and corrected by hand.

stories.title: Democrat Colom flips Mississippi Senate seat
stories.headline: Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat
stories.happened: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in a close race. Officials spent more than a week counting absentee and affidavit ballots before the result was clear. Colom becomes Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction.
stories.tonight: Colom won by about 4,500 votes. Hyde-Smith called him to concede, then posted a video statement.
stories.next: Colom takes his seat when the new Congress meets in January.

stories.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a military base: Sources
stories.headline: Treasury Secretary Bessent moves to a military base
stories.happened: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved out of his Georgetown home and onto a military base in recent weeks. Officials cited security concerns linked to threats from Iran. Earlier media reports had helped identify his home.
stories.tonight: A Treasury spokesperson said he will not be deterred from economic pressure on Iran. He is living on the base for now.

stories.title: White House warns Democrats of "blatant criminality" over possible probes into Trump administration
stories.headline: White House warns top Oversight Democrat about planned probes
stories.happened: White House Counsel Will Scharf sent a letter to Representative Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee. It warned that planned investigations of the administration could amount to criminality. Garcia said the oversight work will go on.
stories.tonight: Democrats take control of Congress in January, and Garcia is expected to chair the committee.
stories.next: The new Congress convenes in January.

local.title: Police arrest suspect in Portland model horse heist
local.headline: Police arrest man accused of selling stolen model horses
local.happened: Portland police arrested Benjamin Moore, 39, after he was seen handing out and selling stolen horse figurines near Powell's Books downtown. He faces several theft charges and two outstanding warrants. Police say he is not charged with the original car break-in.
local.tonight: Most of the collection is still missing; only one or two horses have been turned in. Police are asking anyone who has seen them to call.
